title: How governance research turns model uncertainty into institutional design
titleZh: 治理研究如何把模型不确定性转化为制度设计
question: What changes when AI risk is treated as a coordination problem rather than only a model-quality problem?
questionZh: 当 AI 风险被视为协同治理问题，而不只是模型质量问题时，产品设计会发生什么变化？
method: Conceptual synthesis across AI governance, institutional accountability, and model evaluation literature.
methodZh: 综合 AI 治理、制度问责和模型评测相关文献的概念性分析。
finding: The useful product boundary is a handoff between model evidence, accountable actors, and an operational decision. A digest should preserve all three layers instead of flattening them into a confidence score.
findingZh: 有价值的产品边界，是把模型证据、责任主体和实际决策连接起来。研究简报不应把三者压扁成一个置信度分数。
limitation: This is a structured editorial demo based on public metadata; it is not a systematic review.
limitationZh: 这是基于公开元数据的编辑演示，不是系统性综述。

Treat uncertainty as a product field.

limitation: The example is a workflow demonstration and does not estimate a population-level effect.

methodZh: 对检索、提取、改写、审核和分发交接点的产品工作流分析。

findingZh: 双语偏差经常发生在限定语上：may 被写成 will，样本被写成总体，编辑解读被写成作者论断。质量闸门需要检查这些变化。

title: The smallest provenance field that changes an editorial workflow

methodZh: 为来源状态、检索日期、证据摘录和审核负责人设计字段。
finding: A source-status field creates a useful pause: verified full text, public abstract, metadata only, or user-provided excerpt. Each state implies a different publishing boundary.

question: Which handoffs should stay human-owned when a digest pipeline becomes automated?
questionZh: 当论文简报流水线自动化后，哪些交接仍应由人负责？

methodZh: 基于来源可得性、论断具体性和受众影响的风险加权工作流设计。
finding: Human review is most valuable when a claim is specific, a source is partial, or the audience may act on the brief. Automation can prepare evidence; it should not silently decide publication.
findingZh: 当论断具体、来源不完整或受众可能据此行动时，人工审核最有价值。自动化可以准备证据，但不应静默决定发布。

title: Turn a vague research request into a verifiable question

questionZh: AI 研究助手开始检索前，需求表应该记录什么？

finding: A useful intake form makes the decision, audience, evidence boundary, and acceptable uncertainty explicit before retrieval begins. This reduces the chance that a fluent answer solves the wrong problem.
findingZh: 有效的需求表应在检索前明确决策、受众、证据边界和可接受的不确定性，减少流畅回答解决错问题的情况。

methodZh: 将来源观察、分析者解释、不确定性和迁移条件分开的编辑 schema。

method: Reviewer checklist for claim scope, uncertainty, actor, timeframe, and evidence status across languages.
methodZh: 针对不同语言中的论断范围、不确定性、主体、时间和证据状态的审核清单。
finding: Parity review should compare decision-relevant meaning: who acted, how certain the claim is, and what evidence supports it. Literal fluency can coexist with a changed risk boundary.
findingZh: 一致性审核应比较影响决策的含义：谁做了什么、论断有多确定、证据是什么；文字流畅并不代表风险边界没有变化。
limitation: A real parity score requires blinded bilingual reviewers.
limitationZh: 真实一致性分数需要双语盲审者。
author: AI Research Digest editorial demo

title: Design a subscription loop around a recurring research decision
titleZh: 围绕持续研究决策设计订阅闭环
question: What should make a researcher return to a digest instead of opening a one-off summary?
questionZh: 什么能让研究者回到简报，而不是只打开一次摘要？
method: Product hypothesis connecting recurring topic subscriptions, source verification, saved evidence, and next-action prompts.
methodZh: 将主题订阅、来源核验、证据保存和下一步提示连接起来的产品假设。
finding: A recurring digest earns a return visit when it remembers the researcher’s question and surfaces what changed. Subscription is therefore a workflow commitment, not only an email frequency setting.
findingZh: 当简报记住研究者的问题并指出变化时，才有理由回访；订阅是工作流承诺，而不只是邮件频率设置。
limitation: The return-loop hypothesis needs real activation and retention observation.
limitationZh: 回访闭环假设仍需真实激活和留存观察。
takeaways: Measure return behavior after first value.
author: AI Research Digest editorial demo

title: A changelog for editorial rules and model-assisted workflows
titleZh: 为编辑规则和模型辅助工作流建立变更日志
question: Which workflow changes should be visible to a reader and to a reviewer?
questionZh: 哪些工作流变化应该同时对读者和审核者可见？
method: Change-management template covering rule version, affected content, regression sample, owner, and rollback note.
methodZh: 覆盖规则版本、受影响内容、回归样例、负责人和回滚说明的变更管理模板。
finding: A changelog makes quality changes explainable: a lower release rate may follow a stricter provenance rule rather than a model regression. Version history protects the team from comparing incompatible evaluation runs.
findingZh: 变更日志让质量变化可解释：发布率下降可能是来源规则变严格，而不是模型退化；版本历史也避免比较不兼容的评测运行。
limitation: The local changelog contains demonstration entries only.
limitationZh: 本地变更日志仅包含演示条目。
author: AI Research Digest editorial demo
